memory_capacity_cost_moat.reason: A current 36GB HBM3E placement holds 134 frozen 256 MiB DP6 contexts. Public market reporting puts the memory stack cost at a level that does not itself force specialist work/USD below the precommitted 3x/5x thresholds.
memory_capacity_cost_moat.warning: This does not prove a complete ASIC is cheap or fast.

bulk_bandwidth.reason: Official >1.2 TB/s HBM3E capability leaves attacker-favorable bandwidth-only ceilings well above household baseline; random dependent latency and complete-system economics remain decisive.

bank_locality.reason: Exact frozen trace stress found no material exploitable generic bank/interleave locality in the modeled family.

coupled_latency_hiding_suppression.reason: The defensible barrier is the coupling of mandatory memory-carried dependency with 256 MiB private residency, not memory capacity or bandwidth alone.

public_source_cost_calibration.reason: Public HBM pricing, technology capacity/bandwidth and industry design-cost sensitivities narrow the envelope but cannot supply complete specialized BOM/PPA/power/throughput.

safe_memory_economic_bound.reason: Complete exact-path specialist LCVW and compatible representative home-device median remain absent.

red_team.attacker_favorable_interpretation: A competent attacker may use HBM/GDDR/DDR full-state memory, many resident contexts, shared fixed-function compute and custom controllers. Current public evidence does not conditionally exclude >=5x both work/W and work/USD.
red_team.defender_favorable_interpretation: High HBM prices, controller/package costs, random-access latency, RW5 compute and NRE may still keep the complete specialist below WARN/COLLAPSE; none is currently bounded strongly enough to prove that outcome.

minimum_evidence: exact frozen DP6 parity-correct sustained specialized work/s
all-in specialist system cost or auditable BOM/NRE/yield/volume interval
compatible representative home-device median work/W and work/USD
